### COURSES DESCRIPTION  
**Ph. D in Hadith**  

---

**0401921 Studies in the Foundations of Hadith**  (3 credit Hours)  
This course deals in depth with specific important subjects and terms in the foundations of Hadith in terms of studying, analyzing, and criticizing different viewpoints in this regard. It concentrates on the scientific justification for the applied criteria to distinguish between authentic and unauthentic narratives.

---

**0401922 Studies in Ilal Al- Hadith**  (3 credit Hours)  
This course discusses deeply objective researches in the science of Ilal (the hidden problems either in the chain of narrators or the text of the Hadith); it highlights the different schools of thought or methodologies of scholars in this regard.

---

**0401923 Al-Jarh wa al-Ta’dil (Declaring Unreliable and Improvement)**  (3 credit Hours)  
In this course, there will be a study of Hadith Relaters in accordance to their classifications, and the Chains of the Hadiths, whether they are connected or not. This course discusses the bases of the science of al-Jarh wa al-Ta’dil, its terms, and an applied study to Hadith Narrators.

---

**0401924 Critiqued Narrations in the Two Authentic Hadith Books (Bukhari and Muslim)**  (3 credit Hours)  
This study deals with the reasons which made some of the scholars criticize some of the Hadiths in Bukhari and Muslim and how to deal with them.

---

**0401925 Hadith Jurisprudence**  (3 credit Hours)  
This course deals with a study of the best way of understanding Hadiths, the rules and conditions of this understanding, and then applies study to some chosen Hadiths in order to show the errors occurred in understanding Hadiths.

---

**0401926 Textual studies on Hadith Books**  (3 credit Hours)  
This course discusses certain pages in Hadith books in order that the student can refer to them and understand them easily.

---

**0401927 Studies in Hadith Manners**  (3 credit Hours)  
This course aims to give the student practical knowledge in studying Hadith Manners, what main Hadith Scholars have followed in choosing accounts, editing accounts, their manners in classifying fabricated accounts, and their criteria in this matter.
